seoTitle: Googlebot robots.txt Simulator with Parser Edge Cases
metaDescription: Test URLs the way Google reads robots.txt: accepted typos, merged groups, 500 KiB cut-off, ignored directives and tie-breaks. Free, in your browser.
intro: Models Google's robots.txt handling for a chosen Google crawler and explains the special cases it applied.
why:
Google's parser is forgiving in ways other parsers are not: it accepts frequent misspellings such as Disalow, merges groups with the same name, drops everything past 500 KiB and ignores directives like Crawl-delay.

This simulator follows Google's published documentation and the typo list in its open-source parser. It also falls back from Googlebot-Image or Googlebot-News to the Googlebot group. It is a model, not the live crawler, so confirm important pages in Search Console.
howTo: Read each verdict and the notes about typos or ignored lines.
Confirm in the Search Console robots.txt report.

faq.a: Disallow variants such as dissallow, dissalow, disalow, diasllow and disallaw, plus useragent, user agent and site-map, from its open-source parser.

faq.q: Does Googlebot-Image use the Googlebot group?
faq.a: If no group names it, yes, the most specific matching group is used and Googlebot is the fallback.

faq.q: Is this the real Google result?
faq.a: No. It is a model built from documentation. The Search Console report is authoritative.
